instruction: Set up VS Code to exclude all .pyc files from the file explorer.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VS Code to hide .pyc files (compiled Python bytecode) from file explorer. Evaluator checks settings.json for files.exclude pattern **/*.pyc set to true. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VS Code settings.json file from VM to local cache using get_vm_file
Metric function check_json_settings correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' by accessing expected['expected']
Expected value semantically correct: files.exclude with **/*.pyc pattern properly matches instruction requirement to exclude all .pyc files recursively
Verification logic complete: checks exact requirement from instruction (files.exclude setting with correct glob pattern)
Data flow correct: vm_file getter → settings.json path → check_json_settings metric → compares expected nested dict structure
No missing coverage: instruction has single requirement (exclude .pyc files) and evaluator checks exactly that
Metric logic robust: uses .get() with sentinel to distinguish missing keys from None values, handles JSON parsing errors

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
